head: WORKTREE
summary: Outbox writer and advisory-locked relay in messaging-support, payment port/adapter, changeset 0003 and ITs satisfy all criteria. Tests prove rollback atomicity, Kafka outage recovery, replay without a second event, per-key order and lock exclusion. One minor note on relay transaction length.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: OutboxWriter (requires active tx), OutboxRelay pg_try_advisory_xact_lock, rows marked via published_at; OutboxRelayIT

findings.description: The relay keeps one DB transaction (and advisory lock) open while awaiting each Kafka ack; with batch 100 and a 10s timeout a degraded broker could hold it for a long time, though the first failure stops the run.
findings.suggestion: Note the bound in the ADR or Javadoc, or keep batch size and send-timeout modest.
